comment_regular: Authoritative Oblivion TESNPC auto-stat calculation. For each of 21 skills: major = 25+(level-1), non-major = 5+0.1*(level-1), then add 5+0.5*(level-1) for matching class specialization, then the signed race bonus, cap at 100, and store in TESNPC::baseSkills. The chargen placeholder class suppresses major/specialization contributions. Attributes start from sex-specific race values, add configured +5 class-primary bonuses, then add (level-1) per governed major skill or 0.2*(level-1) per governed non-major skill, capped at 100.
